name: parallel_setup_cost
description: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost to initiate parallel worker processes for a query.
symptoms: Excessive parallel query usage for trivial queries
Increased CPU contention from unnecessary worker processes
Higher memory consumption due to over-provisioned parallel workers
Degraded response time from scheduling overhead
tuning_tips: Increase this value to discourage parallelism for small or simple queries; decrease only if large analytical queries consistently avoid parallel plans despite available workers. Monitor plan choices via EXPLAIN before and after changes.
